Big Snowball Thrower.name: Big Snowball Thrower
Big Snowball Thrower.ability: Throws the snowball onto an enemy from a range of 2.5, dealing 150% ATK Arts damage over the target's position and the adjacent 4 tiles. Can only be used once per round.

Rubber Bullet Sniper.name: Rubber Bullet Sniper
Rubber Bullet Sniper.ability: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns the target for 5 seconds.

Dirty Duelist.name: Dirty Duelist
Dirty Duelist.ability: Has 1/1 ammo. While having 1 ammo, the Dirty Duelist attacks by firing the blunderbuss with 150% ATK and disarms the target for 15 seconds, consuming 1 ammo. While having 0 ammo, the Dirty Duelist attacks with the blunderbuss's bayonet.

Coldhands Caster.name: Coldhands Caster
Coldhands Caster.ability: Attacks can hit up to two targets within range; after two attacks, the next attack inflicts Cold for 5 seconds. Has Status Resistance.

Volatile Originium Slug.name: Volatile Originium Slug
Volatile Originium Slug.ability: Explodes when defeated, dealing 400% ATK Physical damage to nearby enemies within a radius of 1.25.

Amplifying Caster.name: Amplifying Caster
Amplifying Caster.ability: Attacks can hit up to two targets within range and deal splash damage in the surrounding 8 tiles of the target(s).

Criminal Funboat.name: Criminal Funboat
Criminal Funboat.ability: Has +1 aggression level. While moving, deals 100% ATK Physical damage to enemies the Criminal Funboat collides with (With a hitbox of 0.8). Spawns a Former Sailor on the spot (With an offset of 0.2) when defeated.

Manifestation of Suffering.name: Manifestation of Suffering
Manifestation of Suffering.ability: Loses 300 HP every second. (Actually taking unsourced True damage)

Rainbowvore Blade.name: Rainbowvore Blade
Rainbowvore Blade.ability: Attacks can hit up to three targets within range and restores HP equal to 150% of the damage dealt.
Rainbowvore Blade.note: In Duel Channel: Honeydew only, the Rainbowvore Blade will restore HP while outside the circle instead of taking damage with 150% effectiveness.

Knights Together Strong.name: Corrupted Knight
Knights Together Strong.ability: Attacks also damage other enemies in the adjacent 4 tiles to the target. The next attack has a longer wind-up time of 4 seconds but increases the ATK to 300%. Cooldown: 22 sec. Becomes enraged when the Withered Knight is defeated, gaining 80% ATK, 150% MSPD, and 100 ASPD.

Knights Together Strong.name: Withered Knight
Knights Together Strong.ability: Attacks can hit up to two targets within range. The next attack can hit up to three targets within range and fire arrows that sticks to the targets without dealing damage but explodes after 2.5 seconds, dealing 160% ATK Arts damage to the targets and other enemies in the adjacent 4 tiles. Cooldown: 22 sec. Becomes enraged when the Corrupted Knight is defeated, gaining 80% ATK, 150% MSPD, and 100 ASPD.

Snotty Slug.name: Snotty Slug
Snotty Slug.ability: Attacks inflict -15 DEF on the target (stacks).

Plastic Wrap Knight.name: Plastic Wrap Knight
Plastic Wrap Knight.ability: Has a shield for 30 seconds after spawning which grants +3000 DEF and +95.

Lamplighter Knight.name: Lamplighter Knight
Lamplighter Knight.ability: [Glimmering Touch] Targets an enemy within attack range and channels for 7 seconds before unleashing a burst over a 2-tiles area centered on the target's position when the channeling starts (highlighted in orange while the Lamplighter Knight is channeling) that deals 250% ATK Arts damage to enemies caught in its wake. Cooldown: (10) 25 sec.

Unemployed Saxophonist.name: Unemployed Saxophonist
Unemployed Saxophonist.ability: Plays the saxophone for a short time before releasing projectiles in the four cardinal directions that deals 150% ATK Physical damage to the first enemy struck. Cooldown: (10) 20 sec.

Super Blast Robo.name: Super Blast Robo
Super Blast Robo.ability: Immune to Stun. Attacks can hit up to four targets within range with 50% ATK.

Miasma Swarm.name: Miasma Swarm
Miasma Swarm.ability: Revives over 5 seconds when defeated for the first time.

Pompeii.name: Pompeii
Pompeii.ability: Attacks can hit up to four targets within range and inflicts a "burning" debuff to the targets for 10 seconds that deals 20 Arts damage every 0.33 seconds. Erupts after 10 seconds if an enemy is within a radius of 0.8 to Pompeii, dealing 1000 Arts damage to nearby enemies within a radius of 1.4. Becomes enraged when HP falls below 50% for the first time, gaining 40 ASPD.

Spear of Mutation.name: Spear of Mutation
Spear of Mutation.note: From Duel Channel: Honeydew, the Spear of Mutation has 0.9 MSPD.

Super Punch Robo.name: Super Punch Robo
Super Punch Robo.ability: Immune to Stun. [Overload] Punches the target every second for 10 seconds when attacking, with each punch dealing 75% ATK Physical damage and Stunning the target for 2 seconds. Cooldown: (0) 20 sec.

Chocolate Custard Slug.name: Chocolate Custard Slug
Chocolate Custard Slug.ability: Attacks inflict 100% ATK Burn (The Player version).

Chivalrous Trio.name: Jade Twin-Swords
Chivalrous Trio.ability: While present, the Chivalrous Trio takes -40% Physical and Arts damage. Targets the one with the lowest HP among the Chivalrous Trio, and restores the target's HP by 500% of the Jade Twin-Swords's ATK as well as removing all Negative Statuses on them. Cooldown: 15 sec.

Chivalrous Trio.name: Crimson Crescent Blade
Chivalrous Trio.ability: For 2 (4 if the Jade Twin-Swords is present) seconds, stops attacking and nearby enemies within a radius of 1.2 takes 80% ATK Arts damage every second; if the Crimson Crescent Blade is being Stunned, no damage will be dealt. Cooldown: (0) 20 sec.

Pacifist.name: Pacifist
Pacifist.ability: Initially has 4 Broken Blades; the Pacifist has +70% ATK while it has at least 1 Broken Blade, and 1 Broken Blade will be consumed after each attack.

Self-Destruct Ice Slug.name: Self-Destruct Ice Slug
Self-Destruct Ice Slug.ability: Explodes when defeated, dealing 200% ATK Physical damage and inflicts Cold for 10 seconds to nearby enemies within a radius of 1.65.

Starving Vanguard.name: Starving Vanguard
Starving Vanguard.ability: Devours the target when attacking for the first time, instantly defeating them. After devouring, the Starving Vanguard gains 700 DEF but loses 30% MSPD.

Prickly Rocks.name: Prickly Rocks
Prickly Rocks.ability: Has +1 aggression level. When taking damage, deals 300 Arts damage to the source.

Trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
Trebuchet.ability: Throws a boulder at an enemy that is not being Stunned (unless if no other targets are available) within a range of 2.5, dealing 70% ATK Physical damage and Stunning the target for 25 seconds. Cooldown: 13 sec.

Relaxed Burdenbeast.name: Relaxed Burdenbeast
Relaxed Burdenbeast.note: From Duel Channel: Honeydew, the Relaxed Burdenbeast has 0 DEF.

Portal.name: Portal
Portal.ability: When defeated, abducts an enemy, instantly defeating them.

Mutant Carnivorous Plant.name: Mutant Carnivorous Plant
Mutant Carnivorous Plant.ability: Devours an enemy within a range of 1, instantly defeating them, and starts digesting for 40 seconds during which the Mutant Carnivorous Plant is immobilized and unable to devour any more targets.

Master Boxer.name: Master Boxer
Master Boxer.ability: Gains 100% Physical Dodge for 10 seconds after HP falls below 50% for the first time.

Jesselton Williams.name: Jesselton Williams
Jesselton Williams.ability: Starts in the Jailer Form: Arts attack with a range of 3; +70 RES; after three attacks, the next attack hits up to two targets within range and Stuns them for 3 seconds. When defeated in the Jailer Form, revives over 4 seconds and enters the Killer Form: Physical attack with a range of 0.8; +700 ATK, +1000 DEF, 0.9 MSPD, and -1.5 attack interval; frees imprisoned Chained-up Pugilists and Coat-hanger Marksmen immediately after entering the Killer Form; after three attacks, the next attack deals two hits and ignores 60% DEF.

Resort Off-road Vehicle.name: Resort Off-road Vehicle
Resort Off-road Vehicle.ability: Can carry up to 3 allies that are neither Machinas nor bosses.

Mortar Shell Thrower.name: Mortar Shell Thrower
Mortar Shell Thrower.ability: Attacks deal splash damage over the surrounding 8 tiles to the target.

Big Spider Sprayer.name: Big Spider Sprayer
Big Spider Sprayer.ability: Spawns an Originiutant Excrescence on the spot. Cooldown: 5 sec. When defeated, spawns 4 Originiutant Excrescences on the spot.
Big Spider Sprayer.note: Originiutant Excrescences have 500 (-50%) HP and 225 (+50%) ATK.

Explosive Seed.name: Explosive Seed
Explosive Seed.ability: Attacks by launching itself onto the target, destroying the Explosive Seed upon impact.

Quilon.name: Qui'lon, Avatar of the Mahasattva
Quilon.ability: Has Status Resistance. [Breaching of the Five Precepts] The next attack hits 5 times with 90% ATK each. Cooldown: (15) 30 sec.

Grenade Mercenary.name: Grenade Mercenary
Grenade Mercenary.ability: Fires the RPG launcher on an enemy from a range of 3.5, dealing 200% ATK Physical damage over the target's position and the surrounding 8 tiles, and gains 200% MSPD afterward. Can only be used once per round.

Former Sailor.name: Former Sailor
Former Sailor.ability: After three attacks, the next attack Stuns the target for 7 seconds.

Tornado Ninja.name: Tornado Ninja
Tornado Ninja.ability: Spins for 60 seconds, during which the Tornado Ninja is disarmed and nearby enemies within a radius of 1 takes 120% ATK Physical damage every second. Cooldown: 10 sec.

Sui-Xiang.name: Sui-Xiang
Sui-Xiang.ability: Occupies a 5×3 area, and immune to Stun and Freeze. Attacks can hit up to two targets. If not defeated in 9 minutes, destroy the arena, ending the round in a draw. [Faraway Mountains' Thunderclap] Calls down lightning bolts on up to three enemies, prioritizing closer ones, dealing 20% ATK Arts damage every 1.5 seconds to the targets and other enemies in the adjacent 4 tiles for 15 seconds. Cooldown: (10) 30 sec. [Heavensfall] Strikes an enemy with the bladed tail, prioritizing the closest one, dealing 120% ATK Physical damage twice and inflicting a Negative Status which causes the target to take 25% ATK Arts damage every second that increases by 25% in every 3 instances for 15 seconds. Cooldown: (5) 18 sec. [Omnidirectional Breath] Charges up and unleashes horizontal beams into every row to the right side for 7 seconds, which causes enemies in each row to take Physical and Arts damage every second; the damage dealt is 100% ATK to the first enemy in each row and 50% ATK to others behind them. Cooldown: 30 sec.

Tiny Hermit Crab.name: Tiny Hermit Crab
Tiny Hermit Crab.ability: After the first attack, becomes immobilized and has +10% ATK (since Duel Channel: Honeydew) and +300 DEF for 20 seconds.

Sensitive Hoarder.name: Sensitive Hoarder
Sensitive Hoarder.ability: When HP falls below 50%, channels for a short time before splitting into two Sensitive Hoarders with the same HP percentage as the original one.

Maniacal Forager.name: Maniacal Forager
Maniacal Forager.ability: Charges forth after 5 seconds while not being Stunned or Frozen, gaining 33.3% MSPD every 0.33 seconds, stacking additively up to 30 times. The MSPD buff will reset when the Maniacal Forager is Stunned or Frozen. When coming into contact to an enemy while moving, deals (700 × MSPD) Physical damage to them. The first attack while charging deals an additional instance of (600 × MSPD) Physical damage and resets the MSPD buff.

Copper Tongue.name: Copper Tongue
Copper Tongue.ability: Has 1/1 copper coin; while having 1 copper coin, the "Copper Tongue" attacks by spitting it towards the target with 200% ATK and consumes 1 copper coin.

Samivilinn.name: Samivilinn, the Resolution of the Very North
Samivilinn.ability: Occupies a 3×3 area, and immune to Stun and Freeze. If not defeated in 5 minutes, destroy the arena, ending the round in a draw. [Icicle Fall] Attacks hit the entire column the target is in with falling icicles that deals Physical damage. [Surge of Nature] Ensnares an enemy with frozen vines, Stunning the target and dealing 20% ATK Arts damage every second for 10 seconds. Cooldown: (40) 60 sec. Gains the following properties while HP is below 50%: takes -60% Physical and Arts damage; Icicle Fall and Surge of Nature can target up to two enemies.

Flame and Steel.name: Flame and Steel
Flame and Steel.ability: Has Status Resistance and +100 ASPD. [Charge] Locks onto an enemy from a range of 3 and dashes toward the target for 4.5 seconds, during which the "Flame and Steel" gains 200% MSPD. Can only be used once per round. Has +280% ATK and takes -60% Physical and Arts damage while HP is below 50%. When defeated for the first time, revives with 50% HP over 5 seconds, is invulnerable for 10 seconds, and Charge can be used again if already used before revival.

Go! Carcass!.name: Go! Carcass!
Go! Carcass!.ability: When attacked, gains 300% MSPD for 2 seconds; can only trigger once every 5 seconds.

Super Floor Scrubber.name: Super Floor Scrubber
Super Floor Scrubber.ability: When attacked for the first time, gains 100% MSPD and 100 ASPD for 30 seconds.

Traffic Tower Production Model.name: Traffic Tower Production Model
Traffic Tower Production Model.ability: Loses 50 DEF and 1 RES each time the "Traffic Tower" Production Model takes damage. Explodes after 1 second when defeated, dealing 200% ATK Physical damage to nearby enemies within a radius of 1.25 and spawns a Guardian of Quick-Wins on the spot.

Guardian of Quick-Wins.name: Guardian of Quick-Wins
Guardian of Quick-Wins.ability: Loses 50 DEF and 2 RES each time the Guardian of Quick-Wins takes damage.

Firewood Knight.name: Firewood Knight
Firewood Knight.ability: Gains 10% ATK and 5 ASPD each time an ally is defeated, stacking additively up to 10 times.

Flamelet and Softsteel.name: Flamelet and Softsteel
Flamelet and Softsteel.ability: Has +180% ATK while HP is below 50%.

Chained-up Pugilist.name: Chained-up Pugilist
Chained-up Pugilist.ability: Starts in the imprisoned state with -50 ASPD. Enters the freed state after attacking 4 times in the imprisoned state with +50% ATK and attacks ignoring 60% DEF.

Rot Eating Beast.name: Rot Eating Beast
Rot Eating Beast.ability: Attacks inflict a debuff for 10 seconds that deals 100 Arts damage every second; the DoT cannot reduce HP to below 1.

Saint Carmen.name: Saint Carmen
Saint Carmen.ability: Has 3/3 ammo. While having at least 1 ammo, Carmen attacks by firing the handcannon with 200% ATK, consuming 1 ammo in each attack. While having 0 ammo, Carmen attacks by slashing the sword. Every 35 seconds, checks the remaining ammo Carmen has; if he has 0 ammo during a check, Carmen channels until he has full ammo, during which he reloads 1 ammo every 2 seconds.

Megamus.name: Megamus
Megamus.ability: When attacked, gains 300% MSPD for 5 seconds; can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

Javelin Sea Terror.name: Javelin Sea Terror
Javelin Sea Terror.ability: Attacks prioritize targeting the enemy with the lowest HP percentage.
Javelin Sea Terror.note: From Duel Channel: Honeydew, the Javelin Sea Terror has 5000 (base 10000) HP, 1200 (base 800) ATK, 40 DEF, and an attack range of 2.1.

Still Signore dei Lupi.name: Still Signore dei Lupi
Still Signore dei Lupi.ability: Starts in the First Form: immune to Stun and takes -30% Physical and Arts damage. [Hemolytic Horror] Inflicts a permanent "Fear" debuff to up to three enemies on the map, which causes the affected units to lose an increasing amount of HP proportional to their maximum HP every second (starting at 0 and increasing by 0.75% every second, capping at 30% after 40 seconds) and inflicts -70 ASPD on them. When Still Signore loses 20% HP after using Hemolytic Horror or he is defeated, all active Fear will be removed. Cannot use Hemolytic Horror if there are Feared units on the map and within 7 seconds after the last Feared unit leaves the map. Cooldown: 55 sec. (shortened by 5 sec. each time a Feared unit leaves the map). Revives over 10 seconds when defeated in the First Form and enters the Second Form: invulnerable for 10 seconds; +50% ATK and -1.5 attack interval; attacks hit twice; [Furious Howl] Howls for 5.5 seconds, which does nothing. Cooldown: (5) 40 sec.

Coat-hanger Marksman.name: Coat-hanger Marksman
Coat-hanger Marksman.ability: Starts in the imprisoned state with -50 ASPD. Enters the freed state after attacking 4 times in the imprisoned state with +50% ATK and attacks dealing Arts damage.

Will of Arbitration.name: Kal'tsit
Will of Arbitration.ability: Immune to Stun and Freeze. When defeated, release a burst that deals 100% ATK Physical damage to nearby enemies within a radius of 2 and Stuns them for 5 seconds.

Will of Arbitration.name: Mon2tr
Will of Arbitration.ability: Immune to Stun and Freeze. When defeated, release a burst that deals 150% ATK Physical damage to nearby enemies within a radius of 2 and Stuns them for 5 seconds.

Free.name: Free
Free.ability: [Weft and Warp] Attacks the closest enemy from Free's position which will be marked by an ink swirl until Free leaves the map with an ink burst that deals 200% ATK Arts damage to the target and enemies in the 2 adjacent 4 tiles to the target. Cooldown: (2) 5 sec. [Break the Chains] Gains a Barrier that absorbs 7500 Physical and Arts damage but stops Free from moving and attacking for 15 seconds; if the Barrier is not destroyed in this period, Free releases a burst that deals 800% ATK Arts damage to nearby enemies within a radius of 3. Only used if there is an enemy in the burst radius. Cooldown: 20 sec. Revives over 5 seconds when defeated for the first time and gains: +10% ATK; attacks can hit up to two targets within range or hit twice if there is only one target; Weft and Warp now targets the closest and furthest enemy simultaneously; Break the Chains' Barrier absorption is increased to 9000, burst damage to 1200% ATK, and cooldown to 40 sec.
